defects.summary: GET /api/analytics/heatmap trusted the supplied userId query parameter.

defects.summary: Heatmap API response did not match LearningHeatmap DTO and returned sparse minute-only rows.

defects.summary: Invalid days values were silently returned as HTTP 200 with empty learner analytics.

defects.summary: Authenticated learner dismissal was acknowledged as local-only and never persisted.

defects.summary: Deck transition ignored audit insert errors and could commit the status without its required audit event.
defects.root_cause: The status update and admin audit insert were separate operations, and the audit write error was ignored.
defects.fix: Lock the deck row and update status plus audit in one transaction; return failure and roll back both when the audit insert fails.
defects.retest: Go PostgreSQL integration test installs a failing audit trigger, receives HTTP 500 and verifies the deck remains draft; visible archive retest persisted archived state and reason-bearing audit.

defects.summary: Kanji list omitted strokeCount and list/summary ignored strokeCountMin/Max.
defects.root_cause: Admin content list/summary handlers did not project or apply stroke-count filters.
defects.fix: Shared validated parameterized bounds applied to list and summary; Kanji list returns strokeCount.
defects.retest: Visible authenticated Admin Chrome and PostgreSQL counts match; integration test verifies both handlers and invalid bounds.

defects.summary: At 390px the competencies table widened the page and clipped columns.
defects.evidence: Visible browser reproduced 493px document width before fix; after fix 390px document with contained horizontal scroller and all columns reachable.
defects.fix: Wrapped AdminDataTable in max-w-full overflow-x-auto; added regression assertion and visible 390px retest.

defects.summary: Competencies API routes used Admin session guard without per-action content RBAC.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration test verified roleless Admin could reach routes before fix; after fix trusted-Origin roleless requests receive 403 for all seven methods/paths while authorized read succeeds.
defects.fix: Require admin.content.read on GETs and admin.content.write plus CSRF on mutations.

defects.summary: The profile/settings tab row exceeded the mobile viewport and clipped the last tab.
defects.evidence: Visible Chrome 390x844 showed the last tab ending x=411.93 before repair. After repair all four buttons fit x=32..358 and are 48px high; Playwright checks row/text overflow in vi/en/ja.
defects.fix: Use four equal mobile columns, compact mobile labels, and retain the existing desktop flex row.

defects.summary: Streak persistence used stale user_streak column names.
defects.root_cause: Store SQL used config_id and last_active_date while canonical schema uses streak_config_id and last_activity_date.
defects.fix: Align read, insert, conflict target and update expressions to canonical column names.
defects.retest: Canonical PostgreSQL integration test covers GetStreaks and RecordActivity; visible authenticated UI received HTTP 200 and rendered a disposable streak.

defects.summary: Achievement streak client parsed an incompatible response shape.
defects.root_cause: Go returns an object containing a streaks array of flat records; client expected a bare array of nested streakConfig objects.
defects.fix: Parse the response envelope and map the canonical flat fields in the view.
defects.retest: Visible browser rendered current streak, record and remaining freezes from the API response; empty state also rendered correctly.

defects.summary: Learner Analytics discarded Go dailyStats and showed fabricated empty period state from absent/all-time fields.
defects.evidence: Visible Browser Use, isolated anonymous context: /vi/analytics redirected through protected /vi/me?tab=progress to /vi/login?returnTo=...; GET /api/analytics/learner returned 401. Real learner session: 7/30/90 UI filters and refresh returned API 200; disposable study_session rendered 37 minutes, 12 XP, 1 session, then was deleted and verified absent. Empty state rechecked with zero API stats. At 390x844 document width remained 390; unsupported empty insight/skill/path sections stayed hidden. Quality: 244/244 frontend tests, production build and independent review PASS.
defects.fix: Consume localized dailyStats (minutes, XP, sessions), preserve rolling-window boundary dates, fill inactive days, scope period UI to returned range data, and hide API fields not supplied.

defects.summary: Battle UI cannot connect to the local realtime server, so match actions remain disabled.
defects.root_cause: The web client still uses Socket.IO on /socket.io with legacy battle:* events, while the authoritative Go API only mounts plain JSON WebSocket /ws/battle and currently implements a different limited event contract.
defects.fix: Implement the documented Go realtime battle contract and migrate the learner battle client to authenticated /ws/battle, including lobby, bot challenge, question/answer, result persistence, disconnect and reconnect behavior.
defects.retest: Pending; current visible browser remains in a reconnecting state with start disabled.

defects.summary: Learner Battle Lobby requested GET /api/battle/leaderboard, but Go had no corresponding learner route.
defects.root_cause: Only an Admin leaderboard handler was registered; learner UI received 404.
defects.fix: Add a LearnerGuard-protected Go endpoint with ranked bot/PvP aggregates, pagination, viewer rank and empty-state metadata; expose display names only.
defects.retest: Visible filter requests 30d/90d/all returned 200 and rendered empty state; PostgreSQL route contract covers 401, aggregation, pagination, empty window and privacy.

defects.summary: Battle config, bot and recent chat endpoints log SQL errors but return empty arrays with HTTP 200.
defects.root_cause: Handlers query fields/tables that do not exist in the canonical database schema (persona, active and battle.chat_message).
defects.fix: Query canonical bot/config/chat schema, map current UI DTOs, enforce moderation/room membership/limit, and surface database errors.
defects.retest: Visible authenticated Lobby requests each returned 200; canonical PostgreSQL contract covers active/upcoming/draft, anonymous 401, private participant allow/outsider deny and cleanup. Go suite 616 pass, 6 allowed skips; independent review approved.

defects.summary: Dictionary list crashed when canonical lexeme list omitted optional senses.
defects.root_cause: List endpoint DTO provides headword/reading/jlptLevel/shortMeaningVi; frontend treated senses as mandatory and dereferenced length.
defects.fix: Make senses optional and render the canonical Vietnamese short-meaning fallback.
defects.retest: Visible dictionary list/search/detail render; regression test covers absent senses; bookmark state persisted after refresh.

defects.summary: Kanji detail omitted components and returned no examples.
defects.root_cause: Handler selected nonexistent kanji_example fields, silently dropped query failures, and never returned canonical kanji_component rows.
defects.fix: Read canonical word/reading/meaning_vi/han_viet/position examples and component rows; surface database errors; tolerate older UI payloads without components.
defects.retest: Real PostgreSQL test asserts canonical example/component values; visible 390x844 detail renders examples/components without error.

defects.summary: Unified search UI showed empty state despite matching canonical lexemes in Meilisearch.
defects.root_cause: Go queried retired per-domain indexes, read type instead of scope, and returned an envelope while frontend expects a SearchResult array.
defects.fix: Query the populated content_search index with kind scope and return its hits as the frontend array contract.
defects.retest: Visible authenticated browser: 会議 produced 20 results (12 lexeme, 1 kanji, 7 examples); ために grammar scope produced 20; reading and Vietnamese queries worked; no-result state passed; Go handler/client tests passed.

defects.summary: Selecting lexeme/grammar search hits requested retired detail paths and showed a detail error.
defects.root_cause: detailPathForKind mapped lexeme to /api/dictionary/words and grammar to /api/grammar instead of the mounted /api/content routes.
defects.fix: Map lexeme and grammar hits to canonical content detail routes and add a route-contract regression test.
defects.retest: Valid RED/GREEN Vitest and typecheck; visible 390x844 lexeme result 衆議院運営委員会 opened canonical detail with reading/meaning, and grammar ために opened its full explanation with API 200; kanji search detail/stroke requests returned 200; no width overflow.

defects.summary: Unified search JLPT chips ignored the level filter and search hits lacked canonical JLPT metadata.
defects.root_cause: The client filtered only by kind; Meilisearch documents omit jlptLevel, and the grammar projection incorrectly placed jlpt_level in reading. Lexeme/kanji level metadata lives in PostgreSQL.
defects.fix: Hydrate result JLPT levels from canonical lexeme/grammar rows and map kanji levels from canonical level values; clear the grammar reading slot and filter client hits by matching single/composite levels.
defects.retest: Visible 390x844: ために N4 returns only 2 N4 grammar hits; 学生 N1 returns 学士; 日 N5 returns 日. Real PostgreSQL Go integration, handler contract, Vitest, typecheck and 60-second runtime stability pass; no canonical content row changes.

defects.summary: The active launch-promotion modal requests an image from retired localhost:19000, causing a failed image request and Console error on fresh browser sessions.
defects.root_cause: The local app now uses Go filesystem media and the canonical Compose stack no longer starts MinIO, while an existing active announcement still stores a legacy MinIO URL. The image is present in the preserved MinIO data volume at the former host port 9000, but no listener exists at the stored port 19000.
defects.retest: Reproduced in an isolated visible anonymous browser at 390x844; GET /api/announcements and content GETs returned 200, /api/auth/me returned expected 401, and the image request failed with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED. Legacy object returned 200 when the preserved MinIO container was temporarily started on its configured port 9000; container was stopped again.

defects.summary: Public search could return stale draft/inactive hits because Meilisearch reindexing is not implemented.
defects.evidence: Go integration injected an inactive grammar hit alongside an active canonical row; response omitted the inactive hit and retained active row with canonical JLPT level.
defects.fix: Validate each indexed result against the current active lexeme, kanji, grammar, example, or lesson row in PostgreSQL before returning public results.

defects.summary: Cardgen preview returned placeholders and generate wrote to a nonexistent table with an incompatible response.
defects.root_cause: Handlers were stubs; the handler referenced content.cardgen_request, which is absent, instead of the existing learning deck/card/SRS/job schema.
defects.fix: Read active canonical lexeme/grammar/kanji rows without modifying them; validate options; generate private deck, variants, SRS rows and completed job in one transaction with the UI response contract.
defects.retest: POST /api/cardgen/generate, invoked through authenticated visible Cardgen UI: HTTP 200, completed job and private deck returned; 20 cards appeared in the SRS queue. Navigation to flashcards plus refresh retained the 20 due cards. PostgreSQL integration verifies deck ownership/visibility, deck_card, user_flashcard and completed flashcard_gen_job persistence. Content source tables remain read-only.

defects.summary: Sequential global promo modals obstructed Cardgen preview and generation controls.
defects.root_cause: AnnouncementStrip displayed every modal globally and automatically queued the next modal after dismissal.
defects.fix: Limit modal announcements to localized home routes and one modal per home visit; no sequential queue.
defects.retest: Regression tests confirm no dialog on /vi/cardgen and one home modal disappears on dismissal without opening the next; visible Cardgen actions and 390x844 flow pass.

defects.summary: Cardgen preview ignored the requested Japanese/Vietnamese direction.
defects.root_cause: Cardgen preview ignored the requested Japanese/Vietnamese direction.
defects.fix: Apply the selected direction to preview samples and generated cards without mutating canonical content.
defects.retest: Visible preview verified both directions; generated cards use private variants.

defects.summary: Cardgen request decoding accepted valid JSON followed by trailing data.
defects.root_cause: Cardgen request decoding accepted valid JSON followed by trailing data.
defects.fix: Require EOF after the single decoded request value.
defects.retest: Regression test rejects trailing JSON; Go Cardgen integration passes.

defects.summary: Due review API returned SRS metadata without the nested card content required by ReviewSession.
defects.root_cause: Due review API returned SRS metadata without the nested card content required by ReviewSession.
defects.fix: Join active flashcard variants and return the canonical nested card DTO.
defects.retest: Visible review loaded Japanese text/reading and submitted successfully; contract integration passes.

defects.summary: Review submission omitted required previous_due_at and next_due_at columns.
defects.root_cause: Review submission omitted required previous_due_at and next_due_at columns.
defects.fix: Read previous due under row lock, calculate the next schedule, and persist both timestamps atomically.
defects.retest: Visible review persisted across navigation/refresh; PostgreSQL contract asserts review event and schedule.

defects.summary: Learner deck store referenced nonexistent learning.flashcard_deck instead of canonical learning.deck.
defects.root_cause: Learner deck store referenced nonexistent learning.flashcard_deck instead of canonical learning.deck.
defects.fix: Use Prisma-owned learning.deck fields for list/create/update/archive/share/clone/generate and return library DTO fields.
defects.retest: Visible list/create/archive passed; canonical-schema integration CRUD passes.

defects.summary: Deck composer sent titleVi/cards/visibility while Go create/update handlers accepted only name/description, so deck data was not persisted.
defects.root_cause: Deck composer sent titleVi/cards/visibility while Go create/update handlers accepted only name/description, so deck data was not persisted.
defects.fix: Accept the learner composer contract and transactionally link personal card variants without editing canonical vocabulary/kanji/grammar.
defects.retest: Visible create/list/detail/archive succeeded; PostgreSQL contract verifies one persisted Japanese/Vietnamese card.

defects.summary: Deck detail UI requested /api/decks/{id}, a route absent from Go, and received 404.
defects.root_cause: Deck detail UI requested /api/decks/{id}, a route absent from Go, and received 404.
defects.fix: Register owner/public-safe GET /api/flashcards/decks/{deckId} with ordered cards and update the caller.
defects.retest: Visible detail rendered 1-card test deck and 20-card generated deck; integration contract passes.

defects.summary: AutoGen sent level/cardCount, expected total, and omitted required name; backend ignored level and direction.
defects.root_cause: AutoGen sent level/cardCount, expected total, and omitted required name; backend ignored level and direction.
defects.fix: Align payload/response fields and filter active canonical vocabulary, kanji and grammar by level; reverse only private card variants.
defects.retest: Visible numeric preview and 20-card Vietnamese→Japanese deck passed; Go tests cover N5/J5 and all three sources.

defects.summary: CreateCardFromContent could add a card to a private deck owned by another learner.
defects.root_cause: CreateCardFromContent could add a card to a private deck owned by another learner.
defects.fix: Verify active deck ownership in the same transaction before creating/linking a variant.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL regression confirms cross-user write returns ErrNotOwner without card creation.

defects.summary: Share tokens were predictable timestamps.
defects.root_cause: Share tokens were predictable timestamps.
defects.fix: Generate 256-bit URL-safe tokens with crypto/rand.
defects.retest: Share/clone CRUD integration passes using the generated token.

defects.summary: Public system decks may have NULL owner_user_id, but deck listing scanned it into a required Go string and returned 500.
defects.root_cause: Canonical public decks are system-owned and owner_user_id is nullable; new visibility query exposed this row shape.
defects.fix: Select COALESCE(owner_user_id::text, '') for list/detail DTOs and preserve NULL as no owner.
defects.retest: Visible public tab returned 200 and rendered canonical shared decks; integration test covers ownerless public, owned and hidden private decks.

defects.summary: Deck updates with existing cardId values discarded submitted front/back/reading changes.
defects.root_cause: UpdateDeck relinked supplied card IDs without applying the submitted card text.
defects.fix: Preserve omitted text/reading during sparse card updates; update deck-owned custom variants, and create a personal copy when edits target canonical/shared variants.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL regression covers sparse IDs, complete text changes, canonical immutability, and unchanged vocabulary/kanji/grammar source rows.

defects.summary: Deck create/update and card suggestions accepted active custom variants from another learner’s private deck.
defects.root_cause: Variant lookup verified only active status and suggestion query included every active source type.
defects.fix: Allow only active canonical lexeme/grammar/kanji variants or custom variants owned by the target deck; exclude all custom rows from global suggestions.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL regression verifies private custom card is absent from suggestions and rejected by CreateDeck and UpdateDeck; public/canonical sources remain available.

defects.summary: CreateCardFromContent trusted caller-supplied source_type/source_id and persisted variants for missing or inactive content.
defects.root_cause: The handler checked deck ownership but the store inserted source IDs without verifying active canonical vocabulary, kanji or grammar rows.
defects.fix: Require a matching active canonical source row for lexeme/grammar/kanji and return 404 for unavailable content; reject custom/unknown types.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL integration covers unknown/custom IDs, draft source rejection, active lexeme success and handler HTTP 404.

defects.summary: Removed cards stayed in the SRS queue; archiving a deck deleted user_flashcard rows and cascaded review history.
defects.root_cause: Due reads ignored active deck membership while archive pruned user_flashcard without preserving review_event rows.
defects.fix: Filter due and review writes to cards in active owned/public decks; archive orphaned deck-owned custom variants while retaining user_flashcard and review history.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL integration removes a reviewed card, confirms it leaves due/review writes, and verifies SRS/review rows remain after update and archive.

defects.summary: The analytics empty-state title said 7 days even when 30- or 90-day range was selected.
defects.root_cause: Localized emptyTitle copy was static while the selected reporting period is dynamic.
defects.fix: Render a localized emptyTitleDynamic template using the selected day count in both card and empty-state title.
defects.retest: Visible browser verified 30/90-day empty-state titles, 200 range requests and no overflow; regression test verifies the dynamic title; analytics contract suite 4/4 and web typecheck pass.

defects.summary: Frontend lint ratchet found an unused container destructuring in the Cardgen announcement regression test.
defects.root_cause: The test only asserted on the document body but retained the container binding from its render helper.
defects.fix: Remove the unused binding while keeping the real React render/unmount behavior.
defects.retest: Frontend quality gate passes with no new lint debt; 343 indexed tests pass.

defects.summary: The server-rendered module route crashed when the canonical local runtime set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL to an empty string for same-origin browser proxying.
defects.root_cause: The server component reused the browser-only API URL and attempted Node fetch on a relative /api URL instead of using the existing server API URL resolver.
defects.fix: Use getServerApiBaseUrl in server-rendered Modules, Radar detail, and Magazine list/detail pages; this resolver prefers API_URL and handles the intended local topology.
defects.retest: Regression test fails against relative fetch and passes with API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4001. Visible anonymous/authenticated module route returns 200, module/card reads return 200, 390x844 no overflow; web typecheck and 5 targeted tests pass.

defects.summary: NHK News list was hard-coded empty and all article detail/reading/bookmark/flashcard paths called by the learner UI were unregistered.
defects.root_cause: Go exposed only an empty-list stub despite persisted NHK article, bookmark, reading-progress, and flashcard schemas; the client paths had no corresponding router handlers.
defects.fix: Read persisted NHK articles; add guarded detail, progress, bookmark and private custom-flashcard handlers with validation and CSRF on writes.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL integration + full Go suite; visible authenticated/anonymous UI and every new METHOD+PATH; 390x844; runtime stable 60s; disposable fixture cleaned.

defects.summary: Metadata-only RSS article detail rendered a blank reader area without explaining that only its headline was stored.
defects.root_cause: The Go response omitted nil body fields, while the detail page only showed a notice for normal-article summaries; most local feed rows have no stored body.
defects.fix: Return explicit nullable bodyHtml/bodyPlain fields and show localized content-unavailable guidance with the NHK source link when both are empty; preserve normal summary notice and full-body rendering.
defects.retest: Visible Chrome 390x844: metadata-only article shows localized notice and source link; full-content article shows text/vocabulary without notice. API 200/null contract, authenticated session 200, no console errors/overflow. Valid RED reproduced omission failure; GREEN targeted PostgreSQL integration, frontend 344/344, typecheck/build, runtime stable 60s.

defects.summary: Learner placement onboarding screen called a missing status route; placement start omitted question DTOs, completion returned placeholder scoring, and onboarding completion persistence was incomplete.
defects.root_cause: The onboarding client expected an unregistered status API and a question/result contract absent from the Go placement handlers; submit hard-coded a 50% score and session setup omitted required updated_at.
defects.fix: Add session-derived GET status, return canonical published question prompts/options, score submitted option keys against PostgreSQL, and atomically persist placement completion and onboarded_at.
defects.retest: Valid RED for missing status route; PostgreSQL placement integration; Go vet; learner typecheck; visible real-session 20-question submit and refresh; anonymous UI/API gate; 390x844 no overflow or runtime errors; runtime stable 60s.

defects.summary: Career expected a nested response while Go GET returned flat CareerMe; mock-provider fallback hid the mismatch and showed prototype data anonymously.
defects.root_cause: The adapter dereferenced response.state without normalizing Go JSON, while the route mounted CareerRpgProvider mock state.
defects.fix: Normalize the Go response, fetch only persisted learner data, and show localized auth/error states.
defects.retest: Visible anonymous/authenticated UI, API contract regression, real browser refresh and frontend suite passed.

defects.summary: New learner Career profiles inherited fictional Japanese name/company defaults and rank UI filled missing data with prototype values.
defects.root_cause: Database and Go store defaults encoded demo identity and company theme.
defects.fix: Use empty persisted profile defaults and render rank labels only from the seeded canonical rank API.
defects.retest: Prisma migration/deploy and PostgreSQL integration passed; visible learner profile and 8 canonical ranks rendered after refresh.

defects.summary: Missing skill axes appeared as zero-valued measurements in the radar chart.
defects.root_cause: Radar chart treated absent skill rows as numeric zero for both shape and labels.
defects.fix: Show unavailable markers for missing axes and draw the polygon only when every axis has a measurement.
defects.retest: Component regression covers a partial axis set; 390x844 browser E2E uses the real radar component and verifies unavailable values.

defects.summary: An empty rank response removed the rank ladder without telling the learner why it was blank.
defects.root_cause: Career page rendered the ladder only when ranks were non-empty.
defects.fix: Show a localized empty state when the canonical ranks endpoint returns an empty list.
defects.retest: Vietnamese/English/Japanese strings, empty-list component assertion, browser E2E and frontend build passed.

defects.summary: Blank new profiles did not trigger the name form; after typing, flat Go PATCH response was read as response.state so the parent did not update.
defects.root_cause: Onboarding recognized only an obsolete demo-name sentinel and PATCH lacked the same adapter used by GET.
defects.fix: Prompt only for blank names; normalize GET and PATCH through one mapper so any saved name updates the parent and persists.
defects.retest: RED/GREEN tests cover blank and saved names plus flat PATCH mapping; actual visible form submission updated greeting/card and remained saved after refresh.

defects.summary: Daily detail called an unregistered Go API route, so published content appeared missing and learner actions could not reach persistence.
defects.evidence: Visible authenticated and anonymous browser; GET /api/daily/items/{id} 200; Go route integration covers malformed 400 and missing 404.
defects.fix: Added public published-item GET plus learner-session and trusted-origin-protected action routes.

defects.summary: Published daily items without daily_learning_extraction returned failures for quick quiz and flashcard creation.
defects.evidence: Visible item had Japanese text and reading but no extraction; authenticated UI actions previously returned 404.
defects.fix: Build a quiz from published same-locale Japanese content and a card from the item’s saved Japanese text, reading and explanation.

defects.summary: Generated flashcards were not recorded as a daily action and fallback quiz activity stored an empty JSON payload.
defects.evidence: Independent review and mounted-router PostgreSQL integration test.
defects.fix: Persist the generated deck/card count and normalized quiz response using the learner identity from the session.

defects.summary: The public Daily Radar home endpoint returned an empty modules/cards payload despite seeded PostgreSQL content.
defects.evidence: Valid RED/GREEN PostgreSQL integration, 664 Go tests plus race/ARM64 gates, visible anonymous 390x844 browser, and 0/10/30/60 runtime stability.
defects.fix: Query enabled published modules and current published cards, derive categories and spotlight, and include daily widget content in the frontend contract.

defects.summary: Anonymous Daily Standup rendered prototype career identity and rank while the real career endpoint returned 401.
defects.evidence: Fresh anonymous visible browser opened /vi/daily-standup at 390x844. GET /api/career/me returned 401; Daily Standup withheld profile/rank/mock identity and redirected to /vi/login?returnTo=%2Fvi%2Fdaily-standup.
defects.fix: Removed prototype provider/fallback and withheld profile content until the real career response resolves; redirect 401 to localized login.

defects.summary: Clock-in navigated into story flow even when the session expired and the request returned 401.
defects.evidence: Reviewer identified the 401 race; regression test asserts state clearing, localized login redirect, and no story navigation.
defects.fix: Clear sensitive career state and redirect to login on 401; navigate only after clock-in succeeds.

defects.summary: Shared preview route read obsolete study.public_deck and did not match actual learner share tokens or DTO.
defects.evidence: Real visible share UI generated a learning.deck.share_token, but its public route rendered not-found; PostgreSQL integration reproduced the route/storage mismatch.
defects.fix: Read preview-safe fields from learning.deck through FlashcardDeckStore.

defects.summary: Public shared deck preview could be cached after revocation or become stale.
defects.evidence: Visible browser/API acceptance checks confirmed valid and unknown-token responses return Cache-Control: no-store; regression asserts cache control.
defects.fix: Set Cache-Control: no-store on all public preview responses and disable Next fetch revalidation.

defects.summary: A single visible clone action issued two clone POST requests and persisted duplicate learner decks.
defects.evidence: Authenticated visible learner opened the shared preview at 390x844 and activated its Clone CTA. Exactly one POST /api/flashcards/decks/clone/{token} returned 201; the success banner appeared, the one-shot query was removed only after success, and one new user-owned copy persisted. Refresh retained the same copy count, issued no repeat mutation, and document width remained 390px. A separate component regression covers React StrictMode replay, post-clone deck-list refresh, and failed-request retry after a page reload.
defects.fix: Guard the clone mutation synchronously per learner/token; consume cloneToken only after POST succeeds; refresh the deck list and retain failed tokens for retry after reload.

defects.summary: Password reset bearer tokens must never appear in recovery logs or HTTP responses.
defects.evidence: Regression test asserts log output excludes bearer material; visible browser reset flow returned no token in its response.
defects.fix: Keep raw token only in the email delivery path, persist only its hash, and emit token-free server logs.

defects.summary: Credential reset and invalidation of existing sessions must succeed or roll back together.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL transaction tests cover concurrent consumption and rollback when session revocation fails; browser confirmed old session receives 401.
defects.fix: Consume the token, update the credential and revoke sessions inside one transaction.

defects.summary: An in-memory SMTP queue could acknowledge recovery work before transport delivery failed.
defects.evidence: SMTP transport regression exercises real message delivery and localized content; visible form submit produced a Mailpit message.
defects.fix: Use the durable outer worker and wait for actual SMTP transport result before removing a job.

defects.summary: In-memory recovery requests could be lost when the Go API restarted.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration verifies committed outbox work is claimed by a replacement worker and queue admission is bounded.
defects.fix: Persist recovery requests in the PostgreSQL outbox with leases, bounded retries and cleanup.

defects.summary: Reset email links could use an implicit localhost URL or insecure external HTTP origin.
defects.evidence: Config regression rejects SMTP startup without an explicit WEB_PUBLIC_URL; SMTP tests reject external HTTP and accept local loopback HTTP.
defects.fix: Require an explicit public URL when SMTP is configured and permit HTTP only for loopback development.

defects.summary: Fragment, effect replay and stale responses could lose a valid one-time reset token or complete an obsolete token flow.
defects.evidence: Component tests cover Strict Mode, fragment/hash changes and token replacement; visible browser cleared the fragment, reset successfully and rejected replay.
defects.fix: Retain the fragment token across effect replay/hash updates and ignore responses for a replaced token.

defects.summary: An expired worker claim could be retried beyond the configured password-recovery attempt ceiling.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration test asserts an exhausted expired claim is removed without issuing a token or email.
defects.fix: Drop claims already beyond the retry limit before processing.

defects.summary: Review state used a retired schema and upsert omitted updated_at.
defects.fix: Use canonical exercise review state and persist updated_at.
defects.evidence: Canonical PostgreSQL integration test; visible due-review GET 200.

defects.summary: Daily progress used a legacy relation and risked fake zeros.
defects.fix: Aggregate canonical completed sessions and profile goal.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration regression; visible 48/10 persisted after refresh.

defects.summary: Session DTOs differed from the UI and client correctness was trusted.
defects.fix: Align payloads, verify ownership/state and score persisted answers server-side.
defects.evidence: Go integration and visible five-type sessions.

defects.summary: Active screen called a missing generator route.
defects.fix: Add authenticated generation from canonical active content without returning answer keys.
defects.evidence: Go integration; visible POST 200 for all five exercise types without answer keys; removed GET returns 405.

defects.summary: Bilingual examples produced mixed-language word-order tokens.
defects.fix: Filter Latin-script sentences before tokenization.
defects.evidence: Sensitivity test and visible word-order retest.

defects.summary: Answer submission accepted a same-type question that was not assigned to the active session.
defects.root_cause: Session rows did not retain their question IDs and submit handler checked only ownership/type.
defects.fix: Persist assigned exercise IDs on session creation; reject answer submissions unless the question is assigned to that owned active session.
defects.retest: Go PostgreSQL integration rejects an unassigned same-type question with 404 and accepts the assigned one; visible session/answer flow passed.

defects.summary: Due-review API returned scheduling metadata without the nested exercise required by the learner UI.
defects.root_cause: GetDueExercises joined exercise rows but omitted question fields from its response DTO.
defects.fix: Return the nested exercise prompt, choices, correct answer, explanation and level required by the review card.
defects.retest: Canonical PostgreSQL integration asserts nested DTO; visible due-review card rendered disposable persisted content, then fixture was deleted.

defects.summary: Unvalidated level and session placement values could reach database constraints and return 500.
defects.root_cause: Session start persisted raw level/placement values without checking the supported contract.
defects.fix: Validate JLPT level and supported placement/sessionType values before persistence.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration regressions verify an oversized level and invalid placement/sessionType each return 400.

defects.summary: A learner could complete an assigned practice session without answering its questions.
defects.root_cause: Completion updated the session using whatever answer rows existed, including zero, without comparing them to assigned exercise IDs.
defects.fix: Lock the owned session, require one saved answer per assigned exercise, and complete/update totals atomically.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration returns 409 while unanswered; after answering the assigned question it returns 200 with totalQuestions=1, correctCount=1, score=10. Visible ten-question journey completed and persisted progress after refresh.

defects.summary: Explore interpreted paginated list responses as total-count objects and displayed zero.
defects.fix: Add one read-only canonical active-content count endpoint and render validated totals or an unavailable marker.
defects.evidence: Visible Explore request returned 200 with 252175 lexemes, 5787 kanji, and 2149 grammar; PostgreSQL integration verified active rows are counted and draft rows excluded.

defects.summary: The three-item totals ribbon clipped on narrow mobile widths.
defects.fix: Allow the totals ribbon to wrap and hide desktop dividers on mobile.
defects.evidence: Visible browser at 390x844: totals wrapped into reachable rows; document width matched viewport.

defects.summary: Light-gradient discovery cards placed white text over pale surfaces in dark theme.
defects.fix: Add dark gradient, border, and icon surfaces to each pale discovery card.
defects.evidence: Visible dark-theme screenshot showed legible cards; component regression asserts dark surfaces.

defects.summary: PostgreSQL completed_at::date used the database day while the API selected the machine-local day, causing progress to reset early for learners near midnight.
defects.fix: Compute learner-local day bounds from the stored IANA timezone, use a half-open timestamptz range, and fall back to UTC for invalid zones.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration verifies non-UTC midnight boundaries and invalid-timezone UTC fallback; visible Exercises page daily-progress request returned 200.

defects.summary: Feedback form had no real Go API or durable PostgreSQL persistence.
defects.fix: Added public POST /api/feedback with validation, rate limiting and transactional persistence in ops.feedback_submission.
defects.evidence: Visible anonymous and learner UI submissions returned 201 and persisted; disposable rows were deleted; Go PostgreSQL integration tests pass.

defects.summary: Visible fields did not have reliable programmatic labels.
defects.fix: Associated every field with an explicit label/id.
defects.evidence: Visible browser confirmed all four field labels; frontend regression passes.

defects.summary: The form allowed repeated submission while a request was pending.
defects.fix: Added pending state and disabled duplicate submission until completion.
defects.evidence: Component test submits once under repeated activation; frontend gate passes.

defects.summary: Any successful 2xx response could be rendered as saved feedback without requiring the endpoint contract.
defects.fix: Show success only for HTTP 201 and preserve the form on other responses.
defects.evidence: UI regression confirms HTTP 200 is not presented as persistence success; visible POST returned 201.

defects.summary: HTTP 429 had no localized actionable feedback.
defects.fix: Added dedicated rate-limit copy in English, Japanese and Vietnamese.
defects.evidence: Component regression verifies 429 guidance; all three locale messages typecheck/build.

defects.summary: Compact form controls were below a usable mobile touch size.
defects.fix: Set the input/select/submit controls to at least 48px high.
defects.evidence: Visible 390x844 inspection measured 48px controls and no horizontal overflow.

defects.summary: English confirmation copy was ungrammatical.
defects.fix: Corrected the confirmation sentence.
defects.evidence: English copy regression passes; production build passes.

defects.summary: FAQ summaries measured 24px and the feedback link 36px at 390x844, making controls difficult to tap.
defects.fix: Set FAQ summary and feedback link minimum height to 48px while retaining the native details/summary interaction.
defects.evidence: Visible 390x844 Chromium measured all four summaries at 48px and contact at 48px, no overflow; keyboard Enter opens FAQ.

defects.summary: English Help subtitle lacked a space, FAQ answers began with lowercase yes, and the action label was lowercase.
defects.fix: Correct the English subtitle spacing, answer capitalization, and feedback action label.
defects.evidence: Localized-copy regression, visible English page, JSON parse, and frontend gate pass.

defects.summary: Vietnamese Help text promised email support but displayed no support email address.
defects.fix: Describe only the feedback page that is actually available.
defects.evidence: Visible anonymous Vietnamese page now describes and links to feedback only; regression and independent review pass.

defects.summary: Lesson detail route was unavailable and completion state existed only in localStorage.
defects.fix: Added published lesson read and canonical linked content projection, authenticated CSRF-protected PostgreSQL progress persistence, and replaced local-only completion state.
defects.evidence: Visible anonymous/authenticated browser flows and PostgreSQL regression suite pass; refresh persistence verified and fixture cleared.

defects.summary: BJT level detail endpoints were absent; canonical tabs could not load and the screen counted only lesson links instead of available master content.
defects.fix: Added public read-only Go level/lesson/vocabulary/kanji/grammar handlers; level metrics use canonical active counts, lesson completion uses persisted learner state, and grammar search normalizes display whitespace.
defects.evidence: Visible UI/J1 flow and PostgreSQL regression pass; canonical content is read-only and fixtures are removed.

defects.summary: Public BJT lesson-list route disappeared when learner session storage was unavailable.
defects.root_cause: Route registration was nested under the optional learner SessionStore check although published lesson summaries are public.
defects.fix: Register the public route independently; apply OptionalLearnerGuard only when session storage exists.
defects.evidence: Integration regression proves public lesson listing remains HTTP 200 without learner sessions; full Go suite passed.

defects.summary: Public level/catalog reads had no per-client request bound.
defects.root_cause: All level GET handlers were registered without the existing route limiter.
defects.fix: Apply the dedicated 120/minute per-peer-IP/per-operation limiter to all public level reads; reject requests with 429 at limit and fail closed with 503 if unavailable.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL route tests verify success then 429, ignore spoofed X-Forwarded-For, and return 503 when limiter is missing; full Go suite passed.

defects.summary: Public-read rate limiting keyed the proxy address, so Caddy users shared one bucket and could exhaust one another’s allowance.
defects.root_cause: The middleware used RemoteAddr directly even though production requests reach the API through a local Caddy reverse proxy.
defects.fix: Use authn.NormalizeClientIP: honor forwarded client IP only when the immediate peer is loopback; ignore forwarded headers from direct peers.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration gives two forwarded client IPs through a loopback proxy independent 200 responses and returns 429 for a repeated IP; direct-peer spoof test still returns 429. Full Go/frontend gates and stable runtime pass.

defects.summary: Nested vocabulary, kanji and grammar fields did not match the established learner DTO contract.
defects.root_cause: The new level reference queries exposed database JSON with internal property names rather than the response fields already consumed by the lesson detail client.
defects.fix: Return vocabulary senses as meaningVi/pos, kanji components as component/meaningVi and examples as word/reading/meaningVi, and grammar details as explanationVi.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration regression checks each nested response contract and rejects incompatible legacy property names; targeted suite GREEN. Full verification and independent review pending.

defects.summary: J1+ was mapped to JLPT N1 and kanji level 1, duplicating J1 reference content.
defects.root_cause: The level filter trimmed the > prefix from the J1+ equivalency and hardcoded kanji level 1.
defects.fix: Use an empty canonical filter for J1+ until above-N1 vocabulary, grammar and kanji data exists; do not alias N1.
defects.evidence: Regression first failed with J1+ resolving to [N1]/level 1; now asserts zero counts and empty tab responses in PostgreSQL integration.

defects.summary: Public read rate limits treated the Docker Caddy peer as an untrusted shared bridge IP, collapsing all clients into one bucket.
defects.root_cause: Client IP normalization trusted forwarded addresses only from loopback; Linux staging Caddy and API use a Docker bridge.
defects.fix: Configure an isolated static Caddy-to-API edge address, trust only its /32 via TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS, and route Caddy through the API edge alias.
defects.evidence: Regression first failed for remote peer 172.29.254.3; tests now verify trusted proxy clients get independent buckets and another bridge peer cannot spoof X-Forwarded-For. Linux Compose config validation and Go tests pass.

defects.summary: Lesson summaries counted inactive or missing vocabulary, kanji, and grammar links that lesson detail omits.
defects.root_cause: The summary counted curriculum link rows rather than joining each link to its active canonical content record.
defects.fix: Count only active canonical lexeme, kanji, and grammar rows in the level lesson summary query.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL regression failed before the fix with 3/3/3 counts for one active, one inactive, and one missing link per kind. It passes after the fix with 1/1/1, and GET lesson detail returns only the three active linked contents. Full Go 718/718 including race, vet, ARM64; frontend 382/382, typecheck/build and lint debt ratchet; Compose; runtime 0/10/30/60; Chromium smoke 6/6 pass. Independent review pending.

defects.summary: The learner level index and homepage roadmap called an unregistered public GET /api/levels endpoint.
defects.root_cause: The Go API exposed only per-level detail, lessons, and reference routes; the collection caller had no matching handler.
defects.fix: Register a rate-limited public collection endpoint that returns all six ordered BJT levels with localized labels and active canonical counts.
defects.evidence: Anonymous PostgreSQL integration returned all six ordered level definitions and non-empty vi/ja/en labels; active J5 vocabulary/kanji/grammar fixtures each counted once and J1+ remained zero. Valid RED before route, GREEN after; both frontend callers have locale/API regression tests.

defects.summary: BJT level index displayed Vietnamese metadata and English assessment/readiness copy in every locale.
defects.root_cause: LevelsClient used nameVi/descriptionVi and embedded English UI strings instead of locale labels.
defects.fix: Render localized level labels and move assessment, readiness, analytics empty/error copy into vi/en/ja messages.
defects.evidence: Visible vi/en/ja browser views plus locale regression tests and frontend gates pass.

defects.summary: The level screen silently treated analytics failures as an empty learning history.
defects.root_cause: The analytics promise used an empty catch and exposed no distinction between 401/empty and server/network failure.
defects.fix: Treat anonymous 401 as no sessions and display a localized failure state for other HTTP/network errors.
defects.evidence: Frontend regression verifies localized empty state and a separate 500/network failure message; authenticated and anonymous browser checks pass.

defects.summary: Published magazine detail omitted vocabulary and quiz children, leaving the learner article incomplete.
defects.root_cause: Go detail handler selected only the base article row and did not load its Prisma-owned children.
defects.fix: Return ordered vocabulary and quiz DTOs, answer feedback data, and RFC3339 publication time from the detail API.
defects.evidence: Go PostgreSQL integration and visible vi/en/ja learner article route; same-origin GET returned 200 and unknown slug returned 404.

defects.summary: MiniQuiz sent scores to the wrong API base and Go wrote to a retired table while suppressing database failures.
defects.root_cause: Frontend used NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL with localhost:4000 fallback; handler inserted into daily.magazine_read, ignored errors, and discarded score fields.
defects.fix: Post to the same-origin route, persist validated score/total with an idempotent upsert into daily.magazine_user_read, and show localized save failures.
defects.evidence: Visible authenticated MiniQuiz POST 200; PostgreSQL score=1,total=1 survives refresh; Go integration and Vitest regression pass.

defects.summary: The learner magazine index returned false empty pages because the Go list endpoint returned a bare reduced array and ignored filters/pagination; out-of-range pages also generated unbounded offsets.
defects.root_cause: The list handler contract did not match web/mobile envelope fields, ignored kind/page/limit, and did not clamp page values after counting results; the page conflated upstream errors with a genuine empty catalog.
defects.fix: Return a published-only paged envelope with preview fields; support kind and legacy widgetKind filters; clamp out-of-range pages to the last result page; show a localized retryable error on failed requests.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL handler tests cover filtering, paging, published-only results, ordered vocabulary, out-of-range clamping, and DB failure; visible browser verified vi/en/ja, mobile viewport, filters, no-results, navigation, and HTTP 200 page=last for an out-of-range query; frontend regression covers 503.

defects.summary: The seeded vocabulary article did not render its Japanese or Vietnamese introduction.
defects.root_cause: ContentBody ignored contentJson.introduction and introductionVi.
defects.fix: Render both fields and cover the seeded shape with a component regression.
defects.evidence: Visible authenticated learner browser opened the seeded article at 390x844 in vi/en/ja; all locales rendered the Japanese/Vietnamese introduction and localized date, document width stayed 390, no role=alert appeared, and an unknown slug rendered 404. Real session /api/auth/me returned 200. The visible Add to flashcards action created a disposable learner-owned deck (POST 201) and saved the vocabulary card (POST /api/flashcards/cards/from-content 201). PostgreSQL confirmed learner-owned deck/card/SRS rows, custom card text and reading, and unchanged source magazine_vocab_item count. Public decks were filtered from the picker. Runtime passed 0/10/30/60 after API rebuild. Focused regressions and full frontend/Go quality gates pass.

defects.summary: Adding vocabulary displayed temporary local success without saving a card.
defects.root_cause: The shared vocabulary button had no persistence path and detail DTO omitted source row IDs.
defects.fix: Return stable article-vocabulary IDs and save a learner-owned card through the authenticated flashcard API; keep master rows read-only.
defects.evidence: Visible authenticated learner browser opened the seeded article at 390x844 in vi/en/ja; all locales rendered the Japanese/Vietnamese introduction and localized date, document width stayed 390, no role=alert appeared, and an unknown slug rendered 404. Real session /api/auth/me returned 200. The visible Add to flashcards action created a disposable learner-owned deck (POST 201) and saved the vocabulary card (POST /api/flashcards/cards/from-content 201). PostgreSQL confirmed learner-owned deck/card/SRS rows, custom card text and reading, and unchanged source magazine_vocab_item count. Public decks were filtered from the picker. Runtime passed 0/10/30/60 after API rebuild. Focused regressions and full frontend/Go quality gates pass.

defects.summary: An upstream 503 or network outage rendered as not found.
defects.root_cause: The detail route converted every non-2xx and fetch exception into null.
defects.fix: Only 404 maps to notFound; operational failures now throw to the route error boundary.
defects.evidence: Visible authenticated learner browser opened the seeded article at 390x844 in vi/en/ja; all locales rendered the Japanese/Vietnamese introduction and localized date, document width stayed 390, no role=alert appeared, and an unknown slug rendered 404. Real session /api/auth/me returned 200. The visible Add to flashcards action created a disposable learner-owned deck (POST 201) and saved the vocabulary card (POST /api/flashcards/cards/from-content 201). PostgreSQL confirmed learner-owned deck/card/SRS rows, custom card text and reading, and unchanged source magazine_vocab_item count. Public decks were filtered from the picker. Runtime passed 0/10/30/60 after API rebuild. Focused regressions and full frontend/Go quality gates pass.

defects.summary: The picker offered public decks that the backend correctly rejects for writes.
defects.root_cause: Deck list includes public decks, but the picker treated every returned deck as writable.
defects.fix: Filter write choices to the authenticated learner owner and test public deck exclusion.
defects.evidence: Visible authenticated learner browser opened the seeded article at 390x844 in vi/en/ja; all locales rendered the Japanese/Vietnamese introduction and localized date, document width stayed 390, no role=alert appeared, and an unknown slug rendered 404. Real session /api/auth/me returned 200. The visible Add to flashcards action created a disposable learner-owned deck (POST 201) and saved the vocabulary card (POST /api/flashcards/cards/from-content 201). PostgreSQL confirmed learner-owned deck/card/SRS rows, custom card text and reading, and unchanged source magazine_vocab_item count. Public decks were filtered from the picker. Runtime passed 0/10/30/60 after API rebuild. Focused regressions and full frontend/Go quality gates pass.

defects.summary: Authenticated flashcard creation accepted a magazine vocabulary source from an unpublished article when a row ID was supplied.
defects.root_cause: The canonical source check verified the vocabulary row existed but did not verify that its parent article was published.
defects.fix: Require the magazine vocabulary source to join a published article before creating a learner-owned card.
defects.evidence: PostgreSQL integration proves published vocabulary can be saved and draft vocabulary returns not-found; full Go gates and flashcard UI flow pass.

defects.summary: Loto feed contract did not match its caller and failed to enforce pagination/operational errors.
defects.root_cause: The handler returned an incompatible feed shape and did not consistently bound/clamp pagination or surface database iteration errors.
defects.fix: Return the paginated UI DTO, clamp page/limit, and propagate query/scan/rows failures.
defects.evidence: Visible feed 200 envelope and invalid-game 400; PostgreSQL disposable published/generated runs, pagination and error regressions; Go suite 730/730 including race/vet/ARM64; screen retest passed.

defects.summary: Next draw queried a nonexistent column and selected unsuitable generated runs.
defects.root_cause: The handler referenced a column absent from the canonical daily schema and did not restrict candidates to published runs with selected sets.
defects.fix: Query the canonical schema and return the next published generated run with selected sets under {nextDraw}.
defects.evidence: Visible next-draw 200 {nextDraw:null} for empty local dataset and invalid-game 400; PostgreSQL fixture validates published/selected set selection; screen retest passed.

defects.summary: Loto stats converted database failures into successful zero totals.
defects.root_cause: The handler ignored query errors and returned a fabricated success response.
defects.fix: Validate the game and return an operational error when PostgreSQL fails.
defects.evidence: Visible stats 200 {game:"loto6",totalDraws:0} on empty local data and invalid-game 400; PostgreSQL failure regression expects 500; screen retest passed.

defects.summary: Shared announcement banner displayed legacy Vietnamese message on EN/JA pages when translations were absent.
defects.root_cause: Locale selection fell back to the Vietnamese legacy message and did not filter untranslated records.
defects.fix: Use exact-locale CMS title; retain legacy message on VI and hide untranslated announcements on EN/JA.
defects.evidence: Visible 390x844 Loto pages in vi/en/ja: Vietnamese promotion only appears in VI; EN/JA localized pages have no leaked banner; announcement component tests and frontend suite 404/404 pass.

defects.summary: Authenticated Home Progress requested an unregistered latest weekly report endpoint and received 404.
defects.root_cause: No Go route queried analytics.weekly_report for the session learner.
defects.fix: Added an authenticated, learner-scoped latest-report query with 200 null empty contract and database error handling.
defects.retest: Visible Progress tab returned 200 null; PostgreSQL integration verified stored latest row, identity scoping, anonymous 401 and empty result.

defects.summary: Focus timer used a missing table; after migration to learning.study_session, shared study rows could contaminate focus totals and be ended by the focus API.
defects.root_cause: Focus writes/reads targeted a nonexistent gamification.focus_session table; the canonical shared table requires mode scoping.
defects.fix: Persist on learning.study_session, constrain summary/active/end to mode=focus, validate focus mode, and preserve early-stop completion semantics.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL regression seeds completed quiz and active lesson rows and proves they do not affect or get closed by focus; visible browser start/stop passed.

defects.summary: Pricing crashed when the public plan response omitted quota and entitlement collections.
defects.root_cause: The plan-list API returned only identity/configuration fields while Pricing mapped both missing collections.
defects.fix: Return canonical plan entitlements and quotas; handle row/scan failures as 500.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL API integration verifies feature arrays; visible vi/en/ja UI renders all active plans.

defects.summary: Subscription lookup used an unregistered summary contract, accepted caller userId, and queried a noncanonical expiry column.
defects.root_cause: Pricing and Go API disagreed on the summary route and database fields; request identity was trusted.
defects.fix: Load /subscription from the authenticated session identity and use current_period_end; distinguish no row from operational errors.
defects.retest: Visible session request 200; anonymous 401; spoofed userId cannot read another learner; DB-backed integration passes.

defects.summary: Upgrade submit sent planSlug/userId although the API requires planId and derives identity from session.
defects.root_cause: Frontend payload did not match the authoritative checkout handler contract.
defects.fix: Send the selected plan UUID only from the visible UI action.
defects.retest: Visible checkout network request and client regression verify POST body contains only planId.

defects.summary: Checkout attempted to write obsolete subscription_event columns and did not create a pending subscription.
defects.root_cause: Handler SQL drifted from canonical user_subscription/subscription_event schema.
defects.fix: Persist a session-owned pending subscription and checkout_started event atomically; return pending explicitly.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL integration verifies ownership, pending status, one event, invalid plan 400 and anonymous 401.

defects.summary: Repeated checkout requests created duplicate pending subscriptions and events.
defects.root_cause: Checkout inserted a new intent for every POST without serializing/reusing an existing pending intent.
defects.fix: Serialize per learner/plan and reuse the existing pending subscription.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL regression submits twice and verifies the same ID, one pending row, and one event.

defects.summary: A newer pending upgrade hid the learner’s active plan after refresh.
defects.root_cause: Subscription endpoint returned only the latest row and the client treated pending as the active plan.
defects.fix: Return active/trialing subscription separately from pendingSubscription and render both states.
defects.retest: Go PostgreSQL test and UI regression verify active plan remains current while upgrade is pending.

defects.summary: Anonymous upgrade buttons were no-ops.
defects.root_cause: Checkout action returned when no learner identity existed without giving the visitor an auth path.
defects.fix: Link to localized learner Login with a Pricing returnTo target.
defects.retest: Visible anonymous vi/en/ja routes expose the localized sign-in CTA and preserve Pricing return target.

defects.summary: Plan/subscription failures left Pricing without a retryable operational state.
defects.root_cause: Load path did not consistently classify failed responses or expose a retry action.
defects.fix: Show localized recoverable error and retry control.
defects.retest: Component regression verifies 503 error, retry, then successful recovery.

defects.summary: English and Japanese Pricing reused Vietnamese feature/quota labels and plan display-name fallback was incorrect.
defects.root_cause: Locale selection had Vietnamese-only feature labels and applied Vietnamese displayName fields to English pages.
defects.fix: Render locale-specific feature labels and select only the configured field for the active locale.
defects.retest: Visible vi/en/ja checks and localized component tests pass; no untranslated keys on screen.

defects.summary: Privacy policy data-rights and contact instructions were plain text and could not open the referenced destinations.
defects.root_cause: Sections 4 and 5 described Settings > Privacy and Feedback without actionable navigation.
defects.fix: Added locale-preserving Next links with localized, 44px-minimum touch targets in all three supported locales.
defects.retest: Visible Chrome verified vi/en/ja at 390x844, both localized hrefs and labels, no horizontal overflow, and no Console/window errors. Feedback opened /vi/feedback; Settings reached the localized login gate with returnTo=/vi/settings/privacy. Frontend quality gate passed 415/415 tests plus typecheck/build and zero new lint debt.

defects.summary: Learner Profile analytics silently showed zero-valued stats because its request returned 404.
defects.root_cause: MePageClient called the unregistered /api/learner/analytics path and expected dueFlashcards in analytics; the registered analytics endpoint is /api/analytics/learner and due cards come from /api/flashcards/reviews/due.
defects.fix: Use the registered learner analytics endpoint and count cards from the established due-review array response.
defects.retest: Visible Profile requests returned HTTP 200 with expected object/array contracts; authenticated UI and all tabs rendered without console errors. Focused regression and frontend quality verification passed.

defects.summary: Template titles and section counts disappeared from the learner cards.
defects.root_cause: Go DTO fields differed from the UI contract.
defects.fix: Return localized title and section-count fields matching the client contract.
defects.retest: Visible template cards and PostgreSQL metadata regression.

defects.summary: Learner practice could not start/resume or load result/history because session routes were unregistered.
defects.root_cause: The client called session and official-availability endpoints with no registered handlers.
defects.fix: Register guarded Go routes backed by canonical assessment persistence and owner checks.
defects.retest: Visible 21-question journey plus PostgreSQL lifecycle/ownership integration.

defects.summary: Published quiz templates without published questions appeared as playable empty cards.
defects.root_cause: Template listing counted/returned empty tests.
defects.fix: Exclude templates with no published questions from learner selection.
defects.retest: Go regression verifies the empty template is absent.

defects.summary: Session timer displayed nanoseconds as seconds.
defects.root_cause: time.Duration nanoseconds were cast directly to an integer.
defects.fix: Convert remaining duration to rounded-up integer seconds and clamp at zero.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL timer regression observed failing before fix and passed after; visible 45:00 countdown.

defects.summary: Global navigation and promotional surfaces remained visible during timed practice.
defects.root_cause: Active timed questions shared the regular learner shell.
defects.fix: Give the active session a focused route and hide shell chrome/promotional UI.
defects.retest: Visible 390x844 question flow had no chrome, promo or horizontal overflow.

defects.summary: A null calibrated result score rendered as 0/800.
defects.root_cause: The view defaulted a nullable estimatedScore to zero.
defects.fix: Show an unavailable placeholder until a real estimate exists; never invent a score.
defects.retest: Visible completed 10/21 result shows —/800; Vitest covers null and available-score formatting.

defects.summary: Format guidance was hard to read in the dark theme.
defects.root_cause: Guide copy used insufficient contrast tokens.
defects.fix: Use readable semantic text contrast tokens.
defects.retest: Visible Quiz guide and full frontend verification passed.

defects.summary: A timed quiz answer that expired during submission left the learner on a generic error instead of showing the saved result.
defects.root_cause: The Go handler correctly completed the session and returned 409 session expired, while the learner client only attempted result recovery for 403.
defects.fix: Recognize only 409 session expired (and the existing 403 path), fetch the owner-scoped persisted result, and record quiz study progress; preserve generic handling for other 409 conflicts.
defects.retest: Visible 390x844 expiry recovery: a real UI answer received 409 session expired, then loaded GET results 200 and rendered the saved result; Vitest pins status/message handling and PostgreSQL integration pins persisted completion.

defects.summary: Premium learners were denied official BJT simulations despite having the documented entitlement.
defects.root_cause: The official availability handler queried quiz.official while monetization plans define quiz.official_simulation.
defects.fix: Use the canonical quiz.official_simulation key for the server entitlement query; keep the independent quiz.official_simulation.enabled feature flag gate.
defects.retest: PostgreSQL regression links the canonical entitlement to an active plan/subscription and verifies entitled=true with the expected plan slug; frontend availability fixture now uses canonical entitlement and feature-flag keys.

defects.summary: Completing learner Quiz returned 500 when recording the BJT task in the daily study plan.
defects.root_cause: The Go store queried a retired JSON schema, and browser-only progress recording could be lost or duplicated independently of a completed assessment session.
defects.fix: Use Prisma normalized plan/task tables and write bjt_quiz progress in the same transaction as normal or timed-out quiz completion; remove duplicate client-side writes.
defects.retest: Visible Chrome learner Quiz E2E at 390x844 completed all 21 answers (each POST 201), rendered the unavailable score honestly, and retained result/history after refresh. No browser POST /api/gamification/study-plan/progress occurred; the final-answer transaction persisted bjt_quiz (doneCount 4) and same-origin GET /api/gamification/study-plan/today verified it after completion.
